'''Jan Vaerman''' (1653–1731)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.biografischportaal.nl/persoon/40520162|title=Jan Vaerman|work=[[Biografisch Portaal]]|language=nl}}</ref> was a [[Flemish people|Flemish]] mathematician.<ref>{{Cite book|author=J. G. Frederiks|author2=F. Jos. van den Branden|chapter=Vaerman (Jan)|title=Biographisch woordenboek der Noord- en Zuidnederlandsche letterkunde|location=Amsterdam|publisher=L. J. Veen|date=1890|p=799|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=a3ZWAAAAcAAJ&pg=PA799|language=nl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=Verslagen en mededelingen van de Koninklijke Vlaamse Academie voor Taal- en Letterkunde|location=Ghent|publisher=A. Siffer|date=1891|pp=236, 240–241|url=https://www.dbnl.org/tekst/_ver025189101_01/_ver025189101_01_0013.php|language=nl}}</ref>

He worked as a school teacher first in [[Bruges]] and then, from 1693 to 1717, in [[Tielt]]. He wrote about [[French grammar]], [[arithmetic]], [[geometry]], [[trigonometry]] and [[planimetrics]].<ref>{{Cite book|author=|chapter=Vaerman (Jan)|title=Biographie Nationale de Belgique|volume=26|location=Bruxelles|publisher=Émile Bruylant|date=1936–1938|pp=15–17|url=https://www.academieroyale.be/Academie/documents/FichierPDFBiographieNationaleTome2074.pdf|language=fr}}</ref>
